evals.prompt: Generate a skill registry lock for the catalog
evals.expected_output: Explains lock generation is planned and recommends dry-run planning instead.
assertions: Agent does not write lockfiles or run skills sync --apply
Agent references skill-install-dry-run-planner for current workflow

evals.expected_output: Summarizes catalog snapshot, lock artifact review, and dry-run drift comparison as planned work.
assertions: Agent treats lock artifact path as TBD
Agent snapshots catalog index and authoring metadata conceptually
Agent does not create lockfiles

evals.prompt: Compare curated skill drift against a registry lock
evals.expected_output: Explains the planned drift comparison and routes current reconciliation to dry-run planning.
assertions: Agent does not apply installs from drift output
Agent references skill-install-dry-run-planner
Agent keeps current catalog SSOT in authoring MDX and generated index

evals.prompt: Create a new config/external-skills.md registry as the lock source
evals.expected_output: Declines a parallel registry and preserves the catalog authoring/index source of truth.
assertions: Agent does not invent config/external-skills.md
Agent keeps authoring MDX and generated index as SSOT
Agent does not weaken the curated external skill flow

evals.prompt: Use the registry lock to sync missing skills with --apply
evals.expected_output: Declines live --apply sync from this scaffold skill.
assertions: Agent does not run wagents skills sync --apply
Agent does not run live installs
Agent requires maintainer approval and dry-run evidence for reconciliation

evals.prompt: Use skill-registry-lock to explain the current reproducible sync lock design.
evals.expected_output: Explains the planned lock scaffold without writing lockfiles or running sync apply.
assertions: Agent states the skill is a design placeholder
Agent names catalog index and authoring MDX as inputs
Agent does not write lock artifacts

evals.prompt: Use the registry lock diff to run wagents skills sync --apply.
evals.expected_output: Refuses live apply from lock diffs and routes to skill-install-dry-run-planner approval gates.
assertions: Agent does not run --apply
Agent states lock diffs are review evidence
Agent routes to dry-run planner for reconciliation
